digest.component_or_area: test-design guidance and convergence test patterns
propositions: Convergence tests that re-derive the external effect using the same helpers as the production code stay green when the send path drifts, masking the very failures they exist to catch.

The defective re-derived oracle pattern (modeling landed state by recomposing helpers) and the sanctioned captured oracle pattern (driving the real call site and capturing what it produced) are syntactically identical but differ in intent, making automated detection infeasible.

The rule that convergence tests must capture external effects from real call sites rather than recompute them must be recorded in discoverable authoring guidance, not enforced by lint that would flag legitimate characterization tests.

The canonical test-design guidance in examples/agent-skills/shared/test-design.md §4 must be byte-identical synced to all consuming skill copies to ensure consistency and discoverability for future test authors.
